payout_quote: New donor compensation: Earn up to $675 in your first month! Receive special compensation for your first 8 donations completed within 30 days* ... *Compensation amounts are subject to change. New donor compensation is based on completing the stated number of successful donations within 30 days. Referral compensation is paid after the referred donor completes two successful donations.
timing: Paid per successful donation via prepaid debit card; referral pay after referred donor completes 2 successful donations
eligibility: 18+, 110+ lbs, good health; valid photo ID, proof of address, SSN (card/W2/pay stub) or Border Crossing Card; pass screening and physical; twice-weekly max
steps: Find a Grifols center (Biomat USA, PlasmaCare, or Talecris Plasma Resources) and walk in or book
Bring photo ID, proof of address, and SSN documentation
Pass screening and physical exam on first visit (2-3 hours)
Complete your first 8 donations within 30 days to earn the new-donor special compensation
Referral pay lands after your referred donor completes two successful donations
catches: New-donor compensation requires all 8 donations within 30 days; official page: 'Compensation amounts are subject to change.'
Amounts vary by center — some centers advertise up to $675, others up to $720.
First visit takes 2-3 hours with screening; not everyone qualifies.
Grifols' regular per-visit pay ($35-$90) is lower than CSL/BioLife in many markets.
biggest_catch: The bonus only unlocks if you complete all 8 donations inside 30 days — and Grifols' regular per-visit pay skews lower than the big two chains, so consistency matters most here.

repeatable.cadence: Up to twice per week indefinitely as long as you keep passing screening — the first-month new-donor special pay (first 8 donations in 30 days) is one-time per person.
repeatable.note: Ongoing: up to twice per week indefinitely at regular per-visit pay. New-donor first-month special compensation is one-time per person.

maximize: Map your 8 donations inside the 30-day window from day one — miss the window and the bonus is gone. Referrals pay after your friend completes just 2 successful donations, one of the shortest referral thresholds in the industry, so bringing one friend is nearly free money.
notes: Grifols network centers managed by Biomat USA, PlasmaCare, or Talecris Plasma Resources. Official center pages verified 2026-09-23 (Orlando: up to $675; Statesboro/Lakewood: up to $720).

who_pays: Grifols (through its Biomat USA, PlasmaCare, or Talecris center brands) pays you per successful donation via its prepaid debit card program.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, and bring a valid photo ID, proof of address, and SSN documentation — then pass the medical screening and physical. Every visit screens you again; failing means no donation and no pay.
work_available: Grifols centers are open and operating (Biomat USA / PlasmaCare / Talecris locations). The new-donor special compensation is a promo: your first 8 donations must land within 30 days, and official terms say "compensation amounts are subject to change" — confirm your center's current rate before starting.
what_gets_accepted: Successful completed donations only — pass the day's health screening and finish the donation. A deferred screening visit earns nothing and eats into your 30-day bonus window.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first visit is 2-3 hours of screening and physical before any pay; return visits run about 90-180 minutes including waiting. A needle in your arm, twice-weekly trips, and travel — the screening and waiting time is unpaid.
when_cash_arrives: Paid per successful donation to your Grifols prepaid debit card.
